topics.title: Learn About Cyber Threats

phishing.title: Email Phishing
phishing.description: Learn to identify fake emails from Absher, SAMA, banks, and government services. Scammers impersonate trusted organizations to steal your credentials.
phishing.examples: Fake Absher verification emails, fraudulent bank alerts, SAMA impersonation

smishing.title: SMS Scams (Smishing)
smishing.description: Recognize fake Nafath OTP messages, delivery scams from Saudi Post, and fraudulent payment alerts from SADAD.
smishing.examples: Fake Nafath codes, Saudi Post delivery scams, STC/Mobily prize messages

vishing.title: Voice Call Scams (Vishing)
vishing.description: Protect yourself from callers impersonating Ministry of Interior, banks, or telecom companies demanding personal information.
vishing.examples: Fake Ministry of Interior calls, bank verification scams, prize claim calls

tips.title: Quick Safety Tips
tips.tip1: Never share your Nafath or Absher OTP codes with anyone, even if they claim to be from a government agency.
tips.tip2: Check the sender's email address carefully. Official emails from Saudi banks never ask for your password.
tips.tip3: If you receive a call claiming to be from a ministry, hang up and call the official number directly.
tips.tip4: Legitimate organizations like SAMA and banks will never ask for your full card number via SMS.
tips.tip5: Be cautious of messages claiming you won a prize from STC, Mobily, or Zain. Verify through official apps.
tips.tip6: Enable two-factor authentication on all your accounts, especially Absher and banking apps.
